detect_user_ready_for_initiating_transfe.rationale: Hands-free and natural given no button ability, consistent across tasks.
User cannot press buttons; open-mouth is the natural, fast, hands-free readiness trigger.
No button possible for this user, so open-mouth remains the feasible readiness cue.

microwave_time.rationale: The meal is cold fruit (cantaloupe, banana, watermelon) intended to be served cold, so no heating should be applied.

nav_offset_fridge.rationale: programmatic: base[fridge] + morning shift + Energetic component

nav_offset_microwave.rationale: programmatic: base[microwave] + morning shift + Energetic component

nav_offset_sink.rationale: programmatic: base[sink] + morning shift + Energetic component

nav_offset_table.rationale: programmatic: base[table] + morning shift + Energetic component

outside_mouth_distance.rationale: Inside-mouth transfer is used, so the distance parameter does not apply (hard rule).

plate_color_fridge.rationale: programmatic: base color + fridge location offset + morning lighting shift

plate_color_microwave.rationale: programmatic: base color + microwave location offset + morning lighting shift

plate_color_table.rationale: programmatic: base color + table location offset + morning lighting shift

retract_between_bites.rationale: Working on a laptop in front means the arm should clear the screen between bites.

robot_speed.rationale: This cautious user with paralysis prefers slow motion near the body and mouth; working on a laptop in a non-hurried energetic state provides no reason to speed up.

skewering_axis.rationale: Default narrow bites are easier and safer for inside-mouth delivery, and soft fruit does not require perpendicular acquisition.

transfer_mode.rationale: User cannot lean forward due to lack of trunk control, so the robot must deliver directly into the mouth.

wait_before_autocontinue_seconds.rationale: The user is working on the laptop with divided attention, so a longer window is needed to intervene via the nose-dot interface.
